content.title: Southwest CFO talks earnings: Consumer 'has been strong'
content.description:
Southwest Airlines (LUV) reported quarterly earnings results on Wednesday after the closing bell. The company also issued a strong full-year outlook.

Southwest CFO Tom Doxey joins Morning Brief host Julie Hyman to discuss the company's earnings and outlook.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
